Subject: 15% off the Ridgeline 2P — through Sunday
Preview: A 2.1 kg, 3-season shelter for the trips still on your list this year.
Body: You've been eyeing gear. Here's a straightforward reason to move.

The Northbay Ridgeline 2P (NB-TNT-02) is 15% off through Sunday.

What it is: a 2-person, 3-season tent built from ripstop nylon, packed down to 2.1 kg. That weight works well for backpacking trips where every gram counts but you still want a real shelter at camp.

What it's rated for: spring through fall conditions. It's not engineered for winter mountaineering or sustained heavy snow loads — if that's your plan, you'll want a 4-season option.

If your next trip is a summer ridge traverse, a fall lake-basin trip, or a shoulder-season weekend, the Ridgeline handles that ground well.

Offer ends Sunday. No code needed — discount applies at checkout.
